lessons.title: A Job Interview
lessons.context: A short story about Deniz's job interview experience.

paragraphs.tr: Deniz geçen hafta büyük bir şirkette iş görüşmesine girdi.
paragraphs.en: Last week, Deniz had a job interview at a big company.

paragraphs.tr: Görüşmeden önce çok heyecanlıydı ve iyi hazırlanmıştı.
paragraphs.en: Before the interview, he was very nervous and had prepared well.

paragraphs.tr: İnsan kaynakları müdürü ona deneyimleri hakkında sorular sordu.
paragraphs.en: The human resources manager asked him questions about his experience.

paragraphs.tr: Deniz önceki işlerinden ve becerilerinden bahsetti.
paragraphs.en: Deniz talked about his previous jobs and skills.

paragraphs.tr: Görüşme yaklaşık kırk beş dakika sürdü.
paragraphs.en: The interview lasted about forty-five minutes.

paragraphs.tr: Bir hafta sonra işe alındığını öğrenince çok sevindi.
paragraphs.en: A week later, he was delighted to learn that he had been hired.

questions.question: Where did Deniz have his interview?
How did Deniz feel before the interview?
What did the manager ask about?
What happened a week later?

lessons.title: Moving to a New City
lessons.context: A short story about adjusting to life in a new city.

paragraphs.tr: Aylin iş nedeniyle geçen ay İzmir'e taşındı.
paragraphs.en: Aylin moved to Izmir last month because of her job.

paragraphs.tr: Yeni şehirde henüz kimseyi tanımadığı için biraz yalnız hissetti.
paragraphs.en: Since she didn't know anyone in the new city yet, she felt a little lonely.

paragraphs.tr: Zamanla yeni iş arkadaşlarıyla tanıştı ve arkadaş oldu.
paragraphs.en: Over time, she met her new coworkers and became friends.

paragraphs.tr: Hafta sonları şehri keşfetmeye başladı.
paragraphs.en: On weekends, she started exploring the city.

paragraphs.tr: Deniz kenarındaki kafeleri özellikle çok sevdi.
paragraphs.en: She especially loved the cafes by the sea.

paragraphs.tr: Birkaç ay içinde İzmir'i kendi evi gibi hissetmeye başladı.
paragraphs.en: Within a few months, she started to feel like Izmir was her own home.

questions.question: Why did Aylin move to Izmir?
How did she feel at first?
How did she meet people?
What did she especially love?

lessons.title: Learning a New Language
lessons.context: A short story about the challenges and rewards of learning Spanish.

paragraphs.tr: Emre bir yıl önce İspanyolca öğrenmeye karar verdi.
paragraphs.en: Emre decided to learn Spanish a year ago.

paragraphs.tr: Başlangıçta gramer kuralları ona çok zor geldi.
paragraphs.en: At first, the grammar rules seemed very difficult to him.

paragraphs.tr: Her gün en az yarım saat pratik yapmaya çalıştı.
paragraphs.en: He tried to practice for at least half an hour every day.

paragraphs.tr: Filmler izleyerek ve şarkılar dinleyerek de kelime öğrendi.
paragraphs.en: He also learned vocabulary by watching movies and listening to songs.

paragraphs.tr: Bir süre sonra basit cümleler kurabildiğini fark etti.
paragraphs.en: After a while, he realized he could form simple sentences.

paragraphs.tr: Şimdi İspanya'ya gitmeyi ve dilini pratik etmeyi hayal ediyor.
paragraphs.en: Now he dreams of going to Spain and practicing the language.

questions.question: When did Emre decide to learn Spanish?
What seemed difficult at first?
How did he practice besides studying?
options: By watching movies and listening to songs

questions.question: What does he dream of doing now?

lessons.title: A Doctor's Appointment
lessons.context: A short story about a routine visit to the doctor.

paragraphs.tr: Birkaç gündür başı ağrıdığı için Murat doktora gitmeye karar verdi.
paragraphs.en: Since his head had been aching for a few days, Murat decided to go to the doctor.

paragraphs.tr: Randevu için sabah erkenden hastaneye gitti.
paragraphs.en: He went to the hospital early in the morning for the appointment.

paragraphs.tr: Doktor onu dikkatle muayene etti ve birkaç soru sordu.
paragraphs.en: The doctor examined him carefully and asked a few questions.

paragraphs.tr: Sonunda ciddi bir şey olmadığını, sadece yorgunluktan olduğunu söyledi.
paragraphs.en: In the end, the doctor said it wasn't serious, just fatigue.

paragraphs.tr: Murat'a daha çok su içmesini ve dinlenmesini önerdi.
paragraphs.en: The doctor recommended that Murat drink more water and rest.

paragraphs.tr: Murat rahatlayarak eve döndü.
paragraphs.en: Murat returned home feeling relieved.

questions.question: Why did Murat go to the doctor?
When did he go to the hospital?
What did the doctor say the cause was?
What did the doctor recommend?

lessons.title: An Unexpected Guest
lessons.context: A short story about a surprise visit from an old friend.

paragraphs.tr: Bir akşam kapı çaldığında Selin televizyon izliyordu.
paragraphs.en: One evening, Selin was watching television when the doorbell rang.

paragraphs.tr: Kapıyı açtığında yıllardır görmediği bir arkadaşını gördü ve çok şaşırdı.
paragraphs.en: When she opened the door, she saw a friend she hadn't seen for years and was very surprised.

paragraphs.tr: Arkadaşı şehre iş için gelmiş ve onu ziyaret etmek istemişti.
paragraphs.en: Her friend had come to the city for work and wanted to visit her.

paragraphs.tr: Birlikte kahve içtiler ve eski günleri konuştular.
paragraphs.en: They drank coffee together and talked about the old days.

paragraphs.tr: Selin arkadaşını akşam yemeğine kalması için ikna etti.
paragraphs.en: Selin convinced her friend to stay for dinner.

paragraphs.tr: O akşam ikisi de çok güzel vakit geçirdi.
paragraphs.en: That evening, both of them had a wonderful time.

questions.question: What was Selin doing when the doorbell rang?
Who was at the door?
Why had the friend come to the city?
What did Selin convince her friend to do?

lessons.title: A Small Argument
lessons.context: A short story about two friends resolving a misunderstanding.

paragraphs.tr: Can ve Ege plan yaparken küçük bir konuda anlaşamadılar.
paragraphs.en: While making plans, Can and Ege couldn't agree on a small issue.

paragraphs.tr: Can sinemaya, Ege ise bir konsere gitmek istiyordu.
paragraphs.en: Can wanted to go to the cinema, while Ege wanted to go to a concert.

paragraphs.tr: Bir süre tartıştılar ama kimse fikrini değiştirmedi.
paragraphs.en: They argued for a while, but neither changed their mind.

paragraphs.tr: Sonunda bu hafta konsere, gelecek hafta sinemaya gitmeye karar verdiler.
paragraphs.en: In the end, they decided to go to the concert this week and the cinema next week.

paragraphs.tr: Bu çözüm ikisini de mutlu etti.
paragraphs.en: This solution made both of them happy.

paragraphs.tr: Arkadaşlıkları küçük bir tartışmayla bozulmadı.
paragraphs.en: Their friendship wasn't damaged by a small argument.

questions.question: What did Can want to do?
What did Ege want to do?
How did they resolve the disagreement?
options: One of them gave up completely
They did both, on different weeks
They asked a friend to decide

questions.question: How did the argument affect their friendship?

lessons.title: First Day at a New Job
lessons.context: A short story about starting a new job.

paragraphs.tr: Berk'in yeni işteki ilk günüydü ve oldukça gergindi.
paragraphs.en: It was Berk's first day at his new job, and he was quite nervous.

paragraphs.tr: Sabah erken kalktı ve işe zamanında yetişmek için erken çıktı.
paragraphs.en: He woke up early and left early to arrive at work on time.

paragraphs.tr: Ofiste yöneticisi onu ekiple tanıştırdı.
paragraphs.en: At the office, his manager introduced him to the team.

paragraphs.tr: Çalışma arkadaşları ona çok yardımcı ve arkadaş canlısıydı.
paragraphs.en: His colleagues were very helpful and friendly.

paragraphs.tr: Gün boyunca yeni sistemleri ve süreçleri öğrenmeye çalıştı.
paragraphs.en: Throughout the day, he tried to learn the new systems and processes.

paragraphs.tr: Akşam eve yorgun ama mutlu bir şekilde döndü.
paragraphs.en: In the evening, he returned home tired but happy.

questions.question: How did Berk feel on his first day?
Who introduced Berk to the team?
How were his colleagues?
How did he feel at the end of the day?

lessons.title: Planning a Trip Abroad
lessons.context: A short story about planning a first trip abroad.

paragraphs.tr: Ece hayatında ilk kez yurt dışına çıkmayı planlıyor.
paragraphs.en: Ece is planning to go abroad for the first time in her life.

paragraphs.tr: Önce hangi ülkeye gideceğine karar vermesi gerekiyordu.
paragraphs.en: First, she had to decide which country to go to.

paragraphs.tr: Sonunda İtalya'yı seçti çünkü tarihini ve yemeklerini çok merak ediyordu.
paragraphs.en: In the end, she chose Italy because she was very curious about its history and food.

paragraphs.tr: Pasaport ve vize işlemleriyle uğraşmak biraz zaman aldı.
paragraphs.en: Dealing with the passport and visa procedures took some time.

paragraphs.tr: Uçak biletlerini ve otelini internetten ayarladı.
paragraphs.en: She arranged her plane tickets and hotel online.

paragraphs.tr: Seyahatine sadece iki hafta kaldığı için çok heyecanlı.
paragraphs.en: She is very excited because there are only two weeks left until her trip.

questions.question: Is this Ece's first trip abroad?
Which country did she choose?
Why did she choose that country?
How did she arrange her tickets and hotel?

lessons.title: A Memorable Trip
lessons.context: A short story about an unforgettable family trip to the mountains.

paragraphs.tr: Geçen yaz ailem ve ben dağlara bir gezi yaptık.
paragraphs.en: Last summer, my family and I took a trip to the mountains.

paragraphs.tr: Küçük bir kulübede kaldık ve doğayla iç içe olduk.
paragraphs.en: We stayed in a small cabin and were close to nature.

paragraphs.tr: Her sabah erkenden kalkıp yürüyüşe çıktık.
paragraphs.en: Every morning we woke up early and went hiking.

paragraphs.tr: Bir gün gölün kenarında piknik yaptık ve balık tuttuk.
paragraphs.en: One day we had a picnic by the lake and caught fish.

paragraphs.tr: Akşamları ateş yakıp yıldızları izledik.
paragraphs.en: In the evenings, we lit a fire and watched the stars.

paragraphs.tr: Bu gezi ailemle geçirdiğim en güzel anılardan biri oldu.
paragraphs.en: This trip became one of the best memories I've had with my family.

questions.question: Where did the family go last summer?
Where did they stay?
What did they do every morning?
What did they do in the evenings?
options: Lit a fire and watched the stars

lessons.title: Recycling at Home
lessons.context: A short story about a family adopting recycling habits.

paragraphs.tr: Yılmaz ailesi bir süredir çevreye daha duyarlı olmaya çalışıyor.
paragraphs.en: The Yılmaz family has been trying to be more environmentally conscious for a while.

paragraphs.tr: Evde plastik, cam ve kağıt için ayrı kutular kullanmaya başladılar.
paragraphs.en: They started using separate bins for plastic, glass, and paper at home.

paragraphs.tr: Çocuklar da geri dönüşümün önemini okulda öğrendi.
paragraphs.en: The children also learned about the importance of recycling at school.

paragraphs.tr: Artık market alışverişinde kendi file çantalarını kullanıyorlar.
paragraphs.en: Now they use their own reusable bags when shopping at the market.

paragraphs.tr: Bu küçük değişiklikler zamanla alışkanlık haline geldi.
paragraphs.en: These small changes became habits over time.

paragraphs.tr: Aile bu sayede daha az çöp ürettiğini fark etti.
paragraphs.en: The family noticed they were producing less waste as a result.

questions.question: What has the Yılmaz family been trying to do?
What did they start using at home?
options: Separate bins for plastic, glass, and paper

questions.question: Where did the children learn about recycling?
What do they use when shopping now?

lessons.title: Technology in Daily Life
lessons.context: A short story about how technology has changed one family's routines.

paragraphs.tr: Hayrunnisa'nın ailesi son yıllarda teknolojiyi günlük hayatlarına çok kattı.
paragraphs.en: Hayrunnisa's family has incorporated technology into their daily life a lot in recent years.

paragraphs.tr: Artık market alışverişini bile telefondan yapıyorlar.
paragraphs.en: Now they even do their grocery shopping from their phones.

paragraphs.tr: Büyükanne video görüşmeyle torunlarını her gün görebiliyor.
paragraphs.en: The grandmother can see her grandchildren every day through video calls.

paragraphs.tr: Ancak Hayrunnisa bazen teknolojiden uzaklaşmanın da gerekli olduğunu düşünüyor.
paragraphs.en: However, Hayrunnisa sometimes thinks it's also necessary to step away from technology.

paragraphs.tr: Hafta sonları telefonunu kapatıp kitap okumayı tercih ediyor.
paragraphs.en: On weekends, she prefers to turn off her phone and read a book.

paragraphs.tr: Ona göre denge bulmak en önemli şey.
paragraphs.en: According to her, finding balance is the most important thing.

questions.question: How does the family do grocery shopping now?
How does the grandmother see her grandchildren?
What does Hayrunnisa think is also necessary?
What does she do on weekends?
options: Turns off her phone and reads

lessons.title: A Family Wedding
lessons.context: A short story about preparations for a cousin's wedding.

paragraphs.tr: Gizem'in kuzeni bu ay evleniyor ve tüm aile hazırlıklarla meşgul.
paragraphs.en: Gizem's cousin is getting married this month, and the whole family is busy with preparations.

paragraphs.tr: Düğün büyük bir bahçede yapılacak.
paragraphs.en: The wedding will be held in a large garden.

paragraphs.tr: Gizem gelinliğin ve davetiyelerin seçilmesine yardım etti.
paragraphs.en: Gizem helped choose the wedding dress and the invitations.

paragraphs.tr: Akrabalar farklı şehirlerden düğüne gelecek.
paragraphs.en: Relatives will come to the wedding from different cities.

paragraphs.tr: Herkes hem heyecanlı hem de biraz yorgun.
paragraphs.en: Everyone is both excited and a little tired.

paragraphs.tr: Gizem bu düğünün ailenin en güzel günlerinden biri olacağına inanıyor.
paragraphs.en: Gizem believes this wedding will be one of the family's most beautiful days.

questions.question: Who is getting married?
Where will the wedding be held?
What did Gizem help choose?
How does everyone feel?

lessons.title: Volunteering
lessons.context: A short story about a rewarding volunteering experience.

paragraphs.tr: Onur geçen ay bir hayvan barınağında gönüllü olmaya başladı.
paragraphs.en: Onur started volunteering at an animal shelter last month.

paragraphs.tr: Haftada iki gün köpekleri besliyor ve onlarla vakit geçiriyor.
paragraphs.en: Twice a week, he feeds the dogs and spends time with them.

paragraphs.tr: İlk başta işin biraz zor olacağını düşünmüştü.
paragraphs.en: At first, he had thought the job would be a bit difficult.

paragraphs.tr: Ama zamanla bu deneyimin ona çok şey kattığını fark etti.
paragraphs.en: But over time, he realized this experience had taught him a lot.

paragraphs.tr: Barınaktaki diğer gönüllülerle de iyi arkadaş oldu.
paragraphs.en: He also became good friends with the other volunteers at the shelter.

paragraphs.tr: Onur artık her hafta bu deneyimi dört gözle bekliyor.
paragraphs.en: Now Onur looks forward to this experience every week.

questions.question: Where did Onur start volunteering?
How often does he go?
What did he think at first?
options: It would be a bit difficult

questions.question: What did he realize over time?
options: It was a waste of time
The experience taught him a lot

lessons.title: A Difficult Decision
lessons.context: A short story about choosing between two job offers.

paragraphs.tr: Nazlı aynı anda iki farklı iş teklifi aldı.
paragraphs.en: Nazlı received two different job offers at the same time.

paragraphs.tr: Bir tanesi daha yüksek maaşlıydı ama uzun mesai gerektiriyordu.
paragraphs.en: One had a higher salary but required long working hours.

paragraphs.tr: Diğeri daha az maaş veriyordu ama esnek çalışma saatleri sunuyordu.
paragraphs.en: The other paid less but offered flexible working hours.

paragraphs.tr: Nazlı günlerce hangisini seçeceğine karar veremedi.
paragraphs.en: Nazlı couldn't decide which one to choose for days.

paragraphs.tr: Sonunda kendi mutluluğunu düşünerek esnek olanı seçti.
paragraphs.en: In the end, thinking about her own happiness, she chose the flexible one.

paragraphs.tr: Bu kararından hiç pişman olmadı.
paragraphs.en: She never regretted this decision.

questions.question: How many job offers did Nazlı receive?
What did the first offer have?
options: A higher salary but long hours

questions.question: What did the second offer have?
Which one did she choose?

lessons.title: Changing Careers
lessons.context: A short story about switching careers later in life.

paragraphs.tr: Serkan on yıl boyunca muhasebeci olarak çalıştı.
paragraphs.en: Serkan worked as an accountant for ten years.

paragraphs.tr: Ancak zamanla bu işten hiç keyif almadığını fark etti.
paragraphs.en: However, over time, he realized he got no enjoyment from this job.

paragraphs.tr: Küçüklüğünden beri fotoğrafçılığa büyük bir ilgisi vardı.
paragraphs.en: He had had a great interest in photography since childhood.

paragraphs.tr: Cesaretini toplayıp akşamları fotoğrafçılık kursuna gitmeye başladı.
paragraphs.en: He gathered his courage and started attending a photography course in the evenings.

paragraphs.tr: Bir yıl sonra işini bırakıp kendi fotoğraf stüdyosunu açtı.
paragraphs.en: A year later, he quit his job and opened his own photography studio.

paragraphs.tr: Şimdi her sabah işine gitmekten büyük mutluluk duyuyor.
paragraphs.en: Now he feels great happiness going to work every morning.

questions.question: What was Serkan's original job?
What interest did he have since childhood?
What did he do in the evenings?
What did he do a year later?

lessons.title: A Broken Appliance
lessons.context: A short story about a washing machine breaking down.

paragraphs.tr: Bir sabah Handan çamaşır makinesinin çalışmadığını fark etti.
paragraphs.en: One morning, Handan noticed that her washing machine wasn't working.

paragraphs.tr: Önce kendisi tamir etmeyi denedi ama başaramadı.
paragraphs.en: First, she tried to fix it herself but couldn't.

paragraphs.tr: Sonunda bir tamirci çağırmaya karar verdi.
paragraphs.en: In the end, she decided to call a repairman.

paragraphs.tr: Tamirci makinede küçük bir sorun olduğunu söyledi.
paragraphs.en: The repairman said there was a small problem with the machine.

paragraphs.tr: Yarım saat içinde makineyi tamir etti.
paragraphs.en: He fixed the machine within half an hour.

paragraphs.tr: Handan böyle küçük bir sorun için endişelendiğine gülümsedi.
paragraphs.en: Handan smiled at having worried over such a small problem.

questions.question: What did Handan notice one morning?
What did she try first?
Who did she eventually call?
How long did the repair take?

lessons.title: City Life vs. Village Life
lessons.context: A short story comparing life in the city with life in the countryside.

paragraphs.tr: Ahmet şehirde doğdu ama her yaz köydeki dedesini ziyaret ediyor.
paragraphs.en: Ahmet was born in the city, but he visits his grandfather in the village every summer.

paragraphs.tr: Şehirde hayat hızlı, gürültülü ve her zaman kalabalık.
paragraphs.en: Life in the city is fast, noisy, and always crowded.

paragraphs.tr: Köyde ise her şey daha sakin ve doğaya yakın.
paragraphs.en: In the village, on the other hand, everything is calmer and closer to nature.

paragraphs.tr: Ahmet köyde taze hava solumayı ve yıldızları izlemeyi çok seviyor.
paragraphs.en: Ahmet loves breathing fresh air and watching the stars in the village.

paragraphs.tr: Ancak şehirdeki okulunu ve arkadaşlarını da özlüyor.
paragraphs.en: However, he also misses his school and friends in the city.

paragraphs.tr: Ona göre her iki hayatın da kendine göre güzellikleri var.
paragraphs.en: According to him, both lives have their own kind of beauty.

questions.question: Where was Ahmet born?
How is city life described?
What does Ahmet love doing in the village?
options: Breathing fresh air and watching the stars

questions.question: What does Ahmet think about the two lifestyles?

lessons.title: Attending a Concert
lessons.context: A short story about a memorable night at a concert.

paragraphs.tr: Melis ve arkadaşları favori sanatçılarının konserine gitti.
paragraphs.en: Melis and her friends went to their favorite artist's concert.

paragraphs.tr: Konser alanı biletler tükenmeden önce doluydu.
paragraphs.en: The concert area was full before the tickets ran out.

paragraphs.tr: Sanatçı sahneye çıktığında herkes heyecanla bağırdı.
paragraphs.en: When the artist came on stage, everyone shouted with excitement.

paragraphs.tr: Melis en sevdiği şarkı çalınırken arkadaşlarıyla birlikte söyledi.
paragraphs.en: Melis sang along with her friends when her favorite song played.

paragraphs.tr: Konser gece yarısına kadar sürdü.
paragraphs.en: The concert lasted until midnight.

paragraphs.tr: Eve dönerken herkes yorgun ama çok mutluydu.
paragraphs.en: On the way home, everyone was tired but very happy.

questions.question: Whose concert did they go to?
How was the concert area?
What did everyone do when the artist appeared?
Until when did the concert last?

lessons.title: A Misunderstanding Resolved
lessons.context: A short story about two colleagues clearing up a misunderstanding.

paragraphs.tr: Pınar bir sabah iş arkadaşı Kaan'ın kendisine kızgın olduğunu düşündü.
paragraphs.en: One morning, Pınar thought her coworker Kaan was angry with her.

paragraphs.tr: Kaan birkaç gündür ona pek konuşmuyordu.
paragraphs.en: Kaan hadn't been talking to her much for a few days.

paragraphs.tr: Pınar cesaretini toplayıp Kaan'a doğrudan sordu.
paragraphs.en: Pınar gathered her courage and asked Kaan directly.

paragraphs.tr: Meğer Kaan sadece evindeki bir sorunla meşgulmüş.
paragraphs.en: It turned out Kaan had just been busy with a problem at home.

paragraphs.tr: Kaan ona hiçbir şekilde kızgın olmadığını açıkladı.
paragraphs.en: Kaan explained that he wasn't angry with her at all.

paragraphs.tr: İkisi de rahatlayıp gülüşerek çalışmaya devam etti.
paragraphs.en: Both of them felt relieved and continued working, laughing together.

questions.question: What did Pınar think at first?
What had Kaan been doing for a few days?
What was the real reason for Kaan's behavior?
options: He was busy with a problem at home

questions.question: How did the story end?
options: They felt relieved and laughed together

lessons.title: Saving Money for a Goal
lessons.context: A short story about saving up to buy a first car.

paragraphs.tr: Tolga uzun zamandır kendi arabasını almayı hayal ediyordu.
paragraphs.en: Tolga had been dreaming of buying his own car for a long time.

paragraphs.tr: Bu hedefe ulaşmak için her ay maaşının bir kısmını biriktirmeye başladı.
paragraphs.en: To reach this goal, he started saving part of his salary every month.

paragraphs.tr: Gereksiz harcamalardan kaçınmayı öğrendi.
paragraphs.en: He learned to avoid unnecessary expenses.

paragraphs.tr: Bazı arkadaşları onun bu kadar tutumlu olmasına şaşırdı.
paragraphs.en: Some of his friends were surprised that he was so frugal.

paragraphs.tr: Bir yıl sonra hedeflediği parayı biriktirmeyi başardı.
paragraphs.en: A year later, he managed to save the amount of money he had aimed for.

paragraphs.tr: İlk arabasını aldığında büyük bir gurur duydu.
paragraphs.en: When he bought his first car, he felt great pride.

questions.question: What was Tolga dreaming of?
What did he start doing every month?
What did he learn to avoid?
How did he feel when he bought his first car?
